name: Northwoods Shopping Center Phase II
summary: Northwoods Shopping Center Phase II is an outdoor community shopping destination in north San Antonio featuring popular anchors like Barnes & Noble and Old Navy alongside casual dining options. With over 4,500 positive reviews, this accessible center serves as a convenient neighborhood hub for families and professionals seeking national brands in a comfortable open-air setting.
demographics: Northwoods Shopping Center Phase II serves a diverse middle to upper-middle class demographic in north-central San Antonio, attracting families and professionals from nearby residential neighborhoods. The trade area includes a mix of household compositions with median incomes ranging from $50,000 to $85,000, appealing to value-conscious shoppers seeking national brands and convenient services. Primary visitors include working parents aged 30-55 who appreciate the outdoor shopping format and anchor tenants like Barnes & Noble and Old Navy for both everyday needs and leisure activities. The center draws from a 5-7 mile radius with strong daytime traffic from nearby office parks and consistent weekend family shopping patterns.
description: Northwoods Shopping Center Phase II is a prominent outdoor shopping destination located on San Pedro Avenue in San Antonio's thriving north-central corridor. This open-air community center has established itself as a neighborhood favorite by combining popular national retailers with convenient dining options, creating a comfortable and accessible shopping experience for local residents. Anchored by the beloved Barnes & Noble bookstore and the family-friendly Old Navy clothing retailer, the center offers a diverse tenant mix that caters to both everyday shopping needs and leisure activities. The outdoor format provides ample parking and easy access to stores, while the casual dining options make it an ideal spot for families to spend an afternoon browsing, shopping, and enjoying a meal together. With a strong 4.4-star rating from over 4,500 reviews, Northwoods Shopping Center Phase II has proven its value to the San Antonio community as a reliable and welcoming retail hub that balances convenience with quality shopping experiences.
